annotations.title: Best EVs for a use case

description: The published 'best EV for ...' rankings: everyday, long range, long range over 500 km, family, performance. Use it first for 'what are the best EVs for ...' questions (e.g. 'best long-range EVs right now'): pass the slug straight away - best-everyday-evs, best-long-range-evs, best-long-range-evs-over-500-km, best-family-evs or best-performance-evs - and quote the ranking criterion with the list. Without slug: the list of rankings with slug, title, what each optimizes for and the page URL. With slug: that ranking's top 25 models in order with score out of 100, range with its test cycle, DC 10-80 % time and battery (unverified figures marked), the public ranking criterion to quote with the list, and links; the list of rankings comes along. Text plus structured rows.

locale.description: Language of the answer's text and page links (default en): en.

slug.description: A ranking slug from the list this tool gives without slug, e.g. 'best-long-range-evs'. Omit to get the list.

name: get_ranking

terms.description: Terms the data is given under.

total.description: Models that qualified for the ranking.
